zh: 修复单个特性的失败牵连整页的问题：设置写入被拒绝时重新读取存储值，事件分发与滚动缓动逐个隔离，measure 与 sync 分别累计连续失败次数。
en: Fix one feature's failure spreading across the page: a rejected settings write reads the stored value back, event dispatch and scroll easing are isolated per feature, and measure and sync count consecutive failures apart.
